title: STABLE RIVERS: A CASE STUDY IN THE APPLICATION OF TEXT-TO-IMAGE GENERATIVE MODELS FOR EARTH SCIENCES
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating representation and generation biases in the context of fluvial geomorphology (earth sciences) using a text-to-image diffusion model. It does not evaluate religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical frameworks beyond the general mention of algorithmic fairness and domain-specific representation bias.
